messages:
jess_fin: Heads up — vendor Arcadia Analytics sent invoice INV-48923 for $12,450 but AP flagged it as missing PO. Vendor claims this invoice covers two SOWs and a freight charge consolidated on one invoice. Can we route for manual review?

mike_proc: thanks Jess. Can you attach the invoice PDF and the vendor remittance? If there are two SOWs we might need to split to two POs or create a non-PO approval.

jess_fin: attached invoice and vendor email (see thread). vendor included contract ref: C-2024-Arcadia but no PO number. also vendor says shipping charge should be split across PO-789 and PO-790.

sara_fpna: AP auto-match log shows failure: ```MATCH_FAIL: multiple PO candidates found: [PO-789, PO-790] REASON: ambiguous line-item allocation; freight not mapped``` Looks like our three-way match couldn't decide allocation.

rohit_eng: we did the work under two change orders tied to SOW-A and SOW-B. Procurement submitted a change request but procurement never issued the second PO — procurement backlog. vendor should have referenced the original PO, but they used contract ref instead.

amanda_ops: @mike_proc we can either ask vendor to reissue invoice with explicit PO refs (fastest clean fix) or AP can route to Non-PO Review for manual GR/receipt verification and finance approval. Which do you prefer for timing?

mike_proc: vendor reissue is ideal but sometimes slow. For urgency (pay run Friday) set to manual Non-PO Review and flag procurement to issue missing PO. I'll open a PR ticket and route to @sara_fpna for cost-center approval.

procure-bot: Ticket created: PR-4521 — "Arcadia INV-48923: missing PO assignment / split shipping" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: AP Queue Update: Invoice INV-48923 moved to Non-PO Review. Hold timer set 72h. Please attach receipts or approval notes to PR-4521.

sara_fpna: I'll review GL allocation. provisional plan: charge SOW-A -> GL 5601 (product research), SOW-B -> GL 5602 (infra) and split freight pro-rata by line total. Approver: sara_fpna.

jess_fin: great — i'll message vendor asking for reissue and attach our PR-4521 link. If they can't reissue we proceed with manual split and payment hold. :thumbsup:

mike_proc: thanks team. i'll follow up with procurement to expedite PO issuance and update PR-4521 once done.

rohit_eng: added note that deliverables were accepted on 2024-11-02, attaching acceptance email to the ticket to help accelerate approval.

amanda_ops: flagged for Friday payrun. If no vendor reissue by EOD Thursday we pay via manual route per Sara's allocations.

jess_fin: copied. closing loop when PR-4521 has PO or payment record.
